description: SERPINA6 population genetics from gnomAD v4: summed pLoF frequency, carrier and biallelic prevalence estimates, named missense variants, and constraint visualisation
code:
import requests, json
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

GQL = "https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api"
q = """query G($gid: String!) { gene(gene_id: $gid, reference_genome: GRCh38) {
  gnomad_constraint { pLI oe_lof oe_lof_lower oe_lof_upper oe_mis oe_mis_lower oe_mis_upper
                      exp_lof obs_lof exp_mis obs_mis lof_z mis_z }
  variants(dataset: gnomad_r4) { variant_id rsids consequence hgvsp
      genome { ac an af homozygote_count } exome { ac an af homozygote_count } } } }"""
g = requests.post(GQL, json={"query": q, "variables": {"gid": "ENSG00000170099"}},
                  headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}, timeout=120).json()["data"]["gene"]
vs, con = g["variants"], g["gnomad_constraint"]

LOF = {"frameshift_variant","stop_gained","splice_acceptor_variant",
       "splice_donor_variant","start_lost","stop_lost"}
def afreq(v):
    a = c = 0
    for s in ("exome","genome"):
        d = v.get(s)
        if d: a += d.get("ac") or 0; c += d.get("an") or 0
    return a, c, (a/c if c else 0.0)

lofs = [v for v in vs if v["consequence"] in LOF]
sum_af = sum(afreq(v)[2] for v in lofs)
hom_lof = sum((v.get(s) or {}).get("homozygote_count") or 0 for v in lofs for s in ("exome","genome"))

print("=== SERPINA6 population genetics, gnomAD v4 ===")
print(f"pLoF variants catalogued            : {len(lofs)}")
print(f"Summed pLoF allele frequency (q)    : {sum_af:.3e}")
print(f"Predicted heterozygous carriers 2q  : {2*sum_af:.3e}   (about 1 in {1/(2*sum_af):,.0f})")
print(f"Predicted biallelic prevalence q^2  : {sum_af**2:.3e}   (about 1 in {1/sum_af**2:,.0f})")
print(f"Observed pLoF homozygotes in gnomAD : {hom_lof}")
print(f"\nConstraint: pLI={con['pLI']:.2e}  o/e LoF={con['oe_lof']:.3f} "
      f"(90% CI {con['oe_lof_lower']:.3f}-{con['oe_lof_upper']:.3f}, LOEUF={con['oe_lof_upper']:.3f})")
print(f"            observed/expected LoF = {con['obs_lof']}/{con['exp_lof']:.1f};  "
      f"missense o/e={con['oe_mis']:.3f} ({con['obs_mis']}/{con['exp_mis']:.0f})")

print("\n--- Named clinical missense variants ---")
targets = ["Asp389Asn","Asp367Asn","Trp393Ser","Trp371Ser","Leu93His","Leu115His",
           "Ala224Ser","Ala246Ser","Gly335Val","Gly357Val","Thr342Ala","Thr364Ala",
           "Gln232Arg","Gln254Arg"]
for v in vs:
    hp = v.get("hgvsp") or ""
    if any(t in hp for t in targets):
        a, c, f = afreq(v)
        hom = sum((v.get(s) or {}).get("homozygote_count") or 0 for s in ("exome","genome"))
        print(f"  {v['variant_id']:<22} {hp:<22} AC={a:<7} AN={c:<9} AF={f:.4e} hom={hom:<5} {v['rsids']}")

mis = [v for v in vs if v["consequence"] == "missense_variant"]
common = []
for v in mis:
    a, c, f = afreq(v)
    if f > 0.005:
        hom = sum((v.get(s) or {}).get("homozygote_count") or 0 for s in ("exome","genome"))
        common.append((v["variant_id"], v.get("hgvsp"), f, hom, v["rsids"]))
print(f"\n--- Common missense alleles (AF > 0.5%), n={len(common)} of {len(mis)} missense ---")
for r in sorted(common, key=lambda x: -x[2])[:12]:
    print(f"  {r[0]:<22} {str(r[1]):<22} AF={r[2]:.4e} hom={r[3]:<7} {r[4]}")

# ---------------- figure ----------------
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15, 4.6))

ax = axes[0]
cats = ["LoF", "Missense"]
obs = [con["obs_lof"], con["obs_mis"]]
exp = [con["exp_lof"], con["exp_mis"]]
x = np.arange(2); w = 0.36
ax.bar(x - w/2, exp, w, label="Expected", color="#4C72B0", edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.6)
ax.bar(x + w/2, obs, w, label="Observed", color="#C44E52", edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.6)
ax.set_yscale("log"); ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(cats)
ax.set_ylabel("Variant count (log scale)"); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax.set_title(f"A. SERPINA6 is unconstrained\npLI={con['pLI']:.1e}, LOEUF={con['oe_lof_upper']:.2f}", fontsize=10)
for i, (o, e) in enumerate(zip(obs, exp)):
    ax.text(i, max(o, e)*1.5, f"o/e={o/e:.2f}", ha="center", fontsize=9)

ax = axes[1]
lof_afs = sorted([afreq(v)[2] for v in lofs if afreq(v)[2] > 0], reverse=True)
ax.bar(range(len(lof_afs)), lof_afs, color="#DD8452", edgecolor="none")
ax.set_yscale("log"); ax.set_xlabel("pLoF variant rank")
ax.set_ylabel("Allele frequency")
ax.set_title(f"B. {len(lofs)} pLoF alleles, all ultra-rare\nsummed q = {sum_af:.1e}", fontsize=10)
ax.axhline(sum_af, color="black", ls="--", lw=1)
ax.text(len(lof_afs)*0.45, sum_af*1.4, "summed q", fontsize=8)

ax = axes[2]
labels = ["Heterozygous\ncarrier (2q)", "Biallelic\n(q²)"]
freqs = [2*sum_af, sum_af**2]
ax.bar(labels, freqs, color=["#DD8452", "#C44E52"], edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.6)
ax.set_yscale("log"); ax.set_ylabel("Predicted population frequency")
for i, f in enumerate(freqs):
    ax.text(i, f*1.8, f"1 in {1/f:,.0f}", ha="center", fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylim(1e-9, 1e-2)
ax.set_title("C. Predicted frequency of SERPINA6\nnull genotypes (Hardy-Weinberg)", fontsize=10)

plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
